high_level_description: This image captures a person riding a horse in an outdoor setting. The rider is wearing a white shirt, black pants with red stripes on the sides, and a black equestrian helmet. The horse is a chestnut color with a dark mane and tail. The saddle is equipped with a blue pad and a light-colored saddle blanket. The setting appears to be a fenced area, likely a riding arena or paddock, surrounded by lush green trees. The ground is covered with dirt, suggesting it is a natural or semi-natural environment suitable for horse riding.
